roleDefinitions.name: DeploySutra Prime
roleDefinitions.summary: Plan the review, pick the narrowest specialist for each question, stop on missing evidence and hand the human a gate decision.

roleDefinitions.name: Environment Atlas
roleDefinitions.summary: Record which environment and namespace each supplied file claims to describe, so a diff is never read against the wrong target.

roleDefinitions.name: Kubernetes Mapper
roleDefinitions.summary: Explain how the supplied Kubernetes objects relate (Service to workload, Ingress to Service, workload to ConfigMap/Secret/PVC/ServiceAccount).

roleDefinitions.name: Diff Sentinel
roleDefinitions.summary: Own the semantic desired-state diff: every changed field with source line, risk class and redaction.

roleDefinitions.name: Public Exposure Guard
roleDefinitions.summary: Judge whether a change could make a workload reachable from outside the cluster, and say how to verify it.

roleDefinitions.name: Workload Security
roleDefinitions.summary: Review pod/container isolation settings for privilege, root, capabilities, host namespaces and mutable images.

roleDefinitions.name: RBAC Guardian
roleDefinitions.summary: Review Roles, ClusterRoles and bindings for wildcards, Secret access and cluster scope.

roleDefinitions.name: Secret Boundary
roleDefinitions.summary: Keep credentials out of manifests, reports and logs; verify redaction before any report is shared.

roleDefinitions.name: IaC Interpreter
roleDefinitions.summary: Summarise an imported OpenTofu/Terraform plan JSON as action counts per resource type with destructive and replace candidates.

roleDefinitions.name: Drift Witness
roleDefinitions.summary: Keep "desired-state difference" separate from "live drift" and say what evidence real drift detection would need.

roleDefinitions.name: Blast Radius
roleDefinitions.summary: Turn changes into explicit questions and connected resources, marking everything unproven as UNKNOWN.

roleDefinitions.name: Policy Judge
roleDefinitions.summary: Own the rule registry: explain, justify, tune profiles and keep rule IDs stable.

roleDefinitions.name: Resource Budget
roleDefinitions.summary: Review CPU/memory limits and requests and replica changes for capacity risk.

roleDefinitions.name: Rollout Planner
roleDefinitions.summary: Draft a human-run rollout order and abort criteria from the change set. Plans only; never executes.

roleDefinitions.name: Canary Evidence
roleDefinitions.summary: Define what canary/SLO evidence would be required, and refuse to treat absent metrics as healthy.

roleDefinitions.name: Rollback Architect
roleDefinitions.summary: Separate rollback declarations from verified restore evidence; keep the gate blocked until evidence exists.

roleDefinitions.name: Health Gate
roleDefinitions.summary: Hold the gate closed: only BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED exist, and neither is an approval.

roleDefinitions.name: Compliance Witness
roleDefinitions.summary: Prepare auditable evidence: hashes, rule versions, verification steps and honest limits.

roleDefinitions.name: IDE Bridge
roleDefinitions.summary: Install the portable skills into a project for a chosen IDE and report honestly that activation is untested.

roleDefinitions.name: Release Auditor
roleDefinitions.summary: Independently challenge the review: re-run, check evidence, look for overclaims.

roleDefinitions.name: deploy-diff
roleDefinitions.summary: Compare bounded local before and after manifests and explain sources and changed fields.

roleDefinitions.name: iac-sanity
roleDefinitions.summary: Review imported plan action summaries and reject secret echoing and unsupported formats.

roleDefinitions.name: preview-environment
roleDefinitions.summary: Draft controlled pre-deployment review steps without contacting or modifying remote infrastructure.

roleDefinitions.name: rollout-guard
roleDefinitions.summary: Audit static rollout risks, permissions and health evidence before human-controlled release.

roleDefinitions.name: rollback-plan
roleDefinitions.summary: List rollback prerequisites and separate declarations from independently verified restoration evidence.
